title: Transit and Railroad Police
description: Protect and police railroad and transit property, employees, or passengers.

tasks.text: Prepare reports documenting investigation activities and results.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Incident reports drafted from facts; human reviews

tasks.text: Monitor transit areas and conduct security checks to protect railroad properties, patrons, and employees.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI can watch camera feeds; human maintains physical surveillance

dwas.name: Maintain surveillance of individuals or establishments.

tasks.text: Apprehend or remove trespassers or thieves from railroad property or coordinate with law enforcement agencies in apprehensions and removals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live incident response with agencies is human-led

dwas.name: Collaborate with law enforcement or security agencies to respond to incidents.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Direct security activities at derailments, fires, floods, or strikes involving railroad property.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Security operations direction is live human command

tasks.text: Patrol railroad yards, cars, stations, or other facilities to protect company property or shipments and to maintain order.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Patrolling properties is embodied mobile work

tasks.text: Investigate or direct investigations of freight theft, suspicious damage or loss of passengers' valuables, or other crimes on railroad property.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Investigation is human fieldwork with judgment

tasks.text: Examine credentials of unauthorized persons attempting to enter secured areas.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Document validity check aided, human verifies authenticity

dwas.name: Examine personal documentation to ensure that it is valid.

tasks.text: Enforce traffic laws regarding the transit system and reprimand individuals who violate them.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Enforcing rules requires human presence and authority

tasks.text: Provide training to the public or law enforcement personnel in railroad safety or security.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Training content AI-assisted; live instruction and demonstration human

tasks.text: Plan or implement special safety or preventive programs, such as fire or accident prevention.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Fire plans drafted; code compliance and site review human

dwas.name: Develop fire safety or prevention programs or plans.
Direct fire fighting or prevention activities.

tasks.text: Direct or coordinate the daily activities or training of security staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing training programs needs human leadership

tasks.text: Interview neighbors, associates, or former employers of job applicants to verify personal references or to obtain work history data.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Investigative interviews require human rapport

dwas.name: Interview people to obtain information about actions or status of individuals.
